repo_truth: The task worktree and local integration ref equal the bound base/tree and are clean. The required ancestor and local remote-tracking baseline match. The protected checkout is clean and byte-identical at the bound tree. The ordinary validator's inherited HCM-3.5 failure remains an ordinary non-GREEN result, not a selector admission result.
allowed_scope: Independently review the two-file candidate selector/preflight subject against the bound HCM-3.6 exit contract and live 00 through 09 authority.
Identify any P1/P2 selector omission, scope expansion, failure-semantics ambiguity, causal-cadence defect, or immutable/protected-path conflict with exact evidence and smallest in-scope repair.

Return CLEAN only when the selector makes all eight exit criteria, permanent-governance terms, two-commit topology, and local-only boundary discoverable without granting product or future-program authority.
non_goals: Do not edit, format, stage, unstage, commit, create a global handoff or ledger entry, delegate, contact a remote, use the protected checkout, or start the cumulative audit.
Do not waive the inherited HCM-3.5 validator result, declare it GREEN, alter immutable predecessor evidence, or authorize any product/schema/dependency/runtime/public-surface work.
tasks: Review the selector's authority boundary, permanent-exception conditions, evidence requirements, exit-gate completeness, and closeout topology.
Check the preflight record against the supplied base/tree/ancestor/remote and protected-checkout requirements.
Return ordered Critical/Required/Optional/Nit findings with precise evidence and the minimum safe remediation, or CLEAN with a concise verification record.
contracts_and_gates: This is the one planning-stage complete-subject discovery review. P1/P2 findings require one consolidated remediation and a different-fresh closure; no review may follow CLEAN.

A completed Phase-3 exit still requires a separate proof-stage discovery/review/remediation/closure lineage, all applicable validations, an ordinary validator result recorded truthfully, and the new authority decision.
stop_conditions: Return BLOCKED only when review evidence is unavailable; return FINDINGS for a valid P1/P2 selector or authority defect.
Do not approve an ambiguous permanent waiver, an exception that masks another failure, selector scope beyond documentation/control-pack work, or any path that changes immutable predecessor evidence.
